promotion_policy: STABLE zawiera tylko wersje potwierdzone w testach. Nowe funkcje i poprawki najpierw trafiają do BETA.
architecture: 10.12 BETA = frozen 10.11 UI-safe base plus one isolated Friends Reliability overlay. It fixes PC/SWIR -> APP synchronization without touching MIX, Ice or general MOD UI.

versions.label: 10.12 BETA — FRIENDS RELIABILITY
versions.notes: Current beta. Uses only OPEN WebSocket connections for friend protocol, captures code 159 directly, queues PC/SWIR -> APP sync, retries failed/unconfirmed jobs and marks them CONFIRMED only after APP state arrives in 159. Based on frozen 10.11.
